tips: Make sure to pay attention to which weapons he has up, when Calibrum is out of ammo you can poke him and try to harass him that way
You could take cleanse for her ult, play aggressively against her she has no sort of defense
Stay behind minions and play with a stun or heavy CC support

Very easy to predict his movements so play with heavy CC support to stun/charm/other CC him when he tries to pick up his axes, it's pretty easy to hit your Q and maybe three autos with Hail of Blades on him too
Try to bait out his E and then all in him with your Support, stay behind minions. Try to push the wave under turret since he has a hard time CSing already
Just dodge his root with your Passive and try to burst him down, play with a supp that does great burst damage
Harass her when she's using her minigun, pay attention to her W animation so you have time to dodge it
Play with a CC heavy support so the support can engage and you can stand a bit away to try to burst her down with Hail of Blades, do NOT engage if she has stacks on you
He has no escape so poking him and letting your support engage and killing him will most likely not be a problem, just make sure to remember if he has W up or not
Many of his long range abilities are skillshots so try to avoid alot of damage by dodging said skillshots, try to stand on the same side as him so he has a harder time to harass you with his Q
Try to harass her as much as you can while still trying to stay save from her Q and E, this will keep her passive down
Try to dodge her long range Q as much as you can so she doesn't get to charge her R, also be sure to harass her when her W and E abilites are down, they're on quite a long cooldown early on
You have a stronger laningphase than Senna does early on, be sure to take advantage of that and know your limits so she doesn't surprise you with her comeback ability

Try to bait her E by waiting a bit after attacking her so she uses it and wastes it completely, the cooldown is quite long and she loses mana if you dont break it, try to get your jungler to gank when she's hardshoving
Don't stand close to your low health minions, play with a knockup or grab support to stop her from jumping away, try to push the minions under her turret so she loses farm
Be sure to not forget to buy pinkwards, focus him in both fights botlane and in teamfights since he is very vulnerable and has no escape except for his Q, burst him down
Focus Varus in lane and in teamfights, try to stay a little bit further away from your teammates so you dont get secondary ulted, always dodge his Q
Stay away from walls if she is closeby, play aggressively before lvl 6 and try to harass her as much as possible and try to get a kill
Poke and burst with Hail of Blades, she is very squishy, try to kill he quickk in teamfights so she can't CC your team with her feathers
Get away from her when you get marked by her, just don't duel her if you're not really strong, try to wait for engage from your support and then take her out from a distance
Try to go for Poke until you can all in him, go for Hail of Blades for easy poke and trade damage, try to make him run out of mana and then stop his backs or push the wave if he manages to back

SUPERDUPER HARD, buy healing debuff items (executioner), try to push the wave under his turret, try to dodge his abilities as much as you can because when he roots you and pulls you in you're pretty much dead

Try to stay away from friendly minions when he has ult up since he can just E towards you and ult when he E + Qs you. Be sure to save Q for his whirlwind, try to get rid of his passive shield before engaging
